announcement.title: Scarlet 0.6.1 — unpublished stable candidate
announcement.message:
Scarlet 0.6.1 is an unpublished candidate awaiting release review.

This local metadata is not the public update feed.
The candidate includes the approved maintainer, tutorial and credits cleanup.
Existing a11 features are retained; automatic joining is not removed.

Known limitation: quiet sessions can trigger misleading log-reader health alerts.
Read the candidate release notes for test exclusions and other limitations.
Do not distribute this candidate as an approved stable release.
